description: Answers 'who is spending election money, where, and on what?' Give a table (races, candidates, donor_geo, race_geo, flows, spending, vendors, state_local, state_local_geo); optionally cycle (2026, 2022 or 2018), state (2-letter code) and office (H or S). Returns cleaned, rolled-up FEC plus state and city filings. Free keys get every race's totals and national/regional/state donor geography; deeper tables need a PoliSpend purchase.
name: get_political_spending
title: Get political spending (PoliSpend)
